ignoreValues.reason: Blockquote pull-quote rule in .blog-post-content, not a card accent tab. A left rule on a quotation is standard editorial typography and long predates the pattern this rule detects. Re-persisted; previously suppressed earlier in this session.

This is .wcard::before, a bottom-edge underline (bottom:0;width:100%;height:3px) that is scaleX(0) at rest and draws left-to-right on hover. Invisible until hovered, so it is an interaction affordance rather than a static decorative accent, and it sits on the bottom edge rather than the side. It is the site's hover grammar from globals.css section 14.5.
